body:
## Problem

P09 must connect native wells to an exact stored model revision.
The current import service does not expose temporary validated input materialization or derived revision publication.
Caller-supplied cell maps cannot prove the stored geometry, properties, or completion factors.

## Scope

Extend P07 with a typed materialization context for a stored model reference.
Use the isolated pinned OPM parser to inspect active cells, cell depth and volume, geometry, rock properties, and report times.
Provide a temporary property file for native input-grid verification and remove staged files when the context closes.

Add derived model publication through the existing validation and artifact path.
Inherit the parent session and coordinate metadata, preserve the parent revision reference, and report uncertain publication explicitly.
Extend the bounded FIELD profile for explicit completion factors, permeability-thickness, skin, and supported completion directions.
Retain reading of previous profile records without changing supported physics or the pinned OPM dependency.

The P09 owner temporarily owns these import-service files under the lead's agreed interface.
Keep this change separate from native well services and MCP wiring.

## Acceptance

Exercise public materialization, cleanup, derived lineage, validation failures, and publication failures through focused tests.
Make sure that inspected values come from stored inputs through the supported OPM parser.
Record the ownership transfer and profile change in the development guide.
Run the shared repository checks and Linux and macOS CI.

This follow-up supports #10 and extends the completed scope of #8.
Native well and input-grid acceptance remain part of #10.
